thread:
nina: Heads-up: platform wants SDKs to surface a machine-readable routing/quota rejection so Console can show a specific "quota exceeded" flow instead of guessing from 400 text. Sketching v2 error + rollout.
alex: Good. Can we rely on a stable code field? Console needs predictable mapping.
priya: SDK owners here we'll need opt-in behavior and clear migration notes. Avoid breaking existing error handling.
nina: Draft server response when client sends header X-RW-RouteErrors: v2 -> HTTP 409 and JSON like:

{"code":"ROUTE_POLICY_EXCEEDED","policy":"quota.bulk-embeds","allowed":0,"requested":1,"hint":"upgrade","meta":{"org":"o-7"}}

SDKs should expose a typed error RoutePolicyError with properties mapping to those fields.
alex: TS SDK plan: add RoutePolicyError subclass of APIError, constructor flag routeErrorsV2: 'auto'|'on'|'off', env var RW_ROUTE_ERRORS_V2. Do not remap status codes. Effort ~0.5d + tests.
priya: Py SDK mirror: add RoutePolicyError subclass, env var and constructor opt-in. Ensure 'except RedwoodAPIError' continues to catch it. We'll include parsing fallback for legacy 400 text.
nina: Rollout proposal:
- Phase 0: server behind feature flag; header opt-in returns 409+structured JSON.
- Phase 1: SDKs release opt-in versions and docs.
- Phase 2: Console enables header for beta orgs and canary (5%). Collect telemetry + UX feedback.
- Phase 3: flip internal defaults and announce public default with 2-week notice.
alex: Important: do NOT include Retry-After for these errors. SDKs must not auto-retry on RoutePolicyError; that would make things worse. Document prominently.
priya: Telemetry: new event routing.policy_reject with fields code, policy, tenant_hash, sdk_language, frontend. Sample tenants for privacy. Console tile will show counts, top policies, and resolution links when hint.url present.
nina: SDK checklist: export error class, map fields, constructor/env opt-in, unit tests for v2+legacy, changelog, README example.
alex: I'll open a small PR and tag it sdk:route-errors-v2; release as patch with opt-in only.
priya: I'll do the py PR and migration note. No default flips until console canary validates.
deploy-bot: deploy: feature/route-errors-v2 -> canary started (5% traffic). build id: ci-9011. :rocket:
nina: Thanks all  post PR links and any integration test failures here. If we see retries or noisy telemetry we'll pause the flip. :thumbsup:
